audience: two groups: (1) marketing, communications and events leads at companies and organisations planning a virtual, hybrid or broadcast event (webinars, summits, launches, town halls, live streams) and deciding whether to hire a production agency; (2) business owners and marketing leads deciding how to build a customer or brand community, or whether to outsource running it to a community manager or a community agency (community as a service)
voice: plain, practical and calm; written for the person who has to deliver the event or build and run the community; concrete steps over hype; no invented clients, case studies, awards, rankings, prices or numbers; every fact about another brand cites its source and implies no affiliation; never names any client of the agency

product.checked_at: 2026-11-27 from https://virtualagency-os.com/about, /answers/west-peek-productions-fit, /how-west-peek-helps, https://www.westpeekproductions.com/ and the west-peek brain
facts: West Peek Productions, founded in 2020 by Scooter Taylor, is a virtual, hybrid and executive broadcast production company and a Community-as-a-Service and creative agency.
West Peek Productions plans, rehearses and runs online shows: webinars, online conferences, summits, hybrid conferences, investor and board meetings and leadership broadcasts.
West Peek Productions produces events on the platform the client already uses, such as Zoom Webinars, Microsoft Teams, ON24 or StreamYard, and can help the client choose one.

Every produced event includes a run of show owned by the producer, a speaker brief and full rehearsal on the real platform two to five days before going live, and a branded slide template and lower thirds.
Every produced event also includes a live producer, Q&A moderation, a backup stream ready to switch to, and the edited recording and clips delivered within 24 to 48 hours.
A simple webinar runs with one producer; summits and hybrid events add a show caller, speaker manager, moderator and platform operator, and a hybrid event adds a venue AV liaison.
Typical lead time is three to four weeks for a moderated webinar and six to eight weeks for an executive summit, online conference or hybrid conference.
West Peek Productions' services are content production, podcast production, virtual and hybrid event production, Community-As-A-Service, brand strategy and web development.
Community as a Service means West Peek Productions helps a brand or company design, launch, operate, engage, measure or scale its own community.
West Peek Productions also scopes marketing, content, creative and community operations and AI workflow setup per engagement; AI output stays a draft until a named person approves it.
West Peek Productions has produced more than 400 virtual and hybrid events.
West Peek Productions is headquartered in New York and also works from Atlanta and Memphis.
It works with foundations, mission-led institutions and nonprofits, brands and influencers, and associations and membership organizations, often extending a small marketing team.

To get a quote, a client sends the date, the audience and what cannot go wrong, and West Peek Productions sends back a production plan and a price range; commercial work is quoted and contracted at westpeekproductions.com.
West Peek Productions does not require long contracts or rigid scopes.
virtualagency-os.com (VirtualAgency OS) is West Peek Productions' answer library, not its storefront.
lacks: West Peek Productions does not sell event software or platform licences; the platform is a separate purchase from production.
West Peek Productions has no fixed price list: each job is scoped and quoted.
West Peek Productions is not a tool reseller, a volume content shop or a growth-hack operation.
